description: Master channel conversations, file sharing, meeting controls, and status settings.
objectives: Use Video call controls (mute, camera, screen share)

steps.title: Welcome to Teams
steps.content: Microsoft Teams centralizes group messaging, video calling, and document co-editing.

quiz.question: What is the difference between a Channel post and a Direct Chat in Teams?
options: Channel posts are visible to all team members, while Direct Chats are private to specific participants
Channel posts can only contain text without attachments
Direct Chats require scheduling 24 hours in advance
quiz.explanation: Channels are public discussion spaces for a team project, whereas Direct Chats are private 1-on-1 or group conversations.
